messages:
Tess: quick follow-up from the postmortem this morning. recurring OOMs on inference workers tied to slow per-shard resident growth + fragmentation. need owners for profiling, short-term guards, and alerts.

Tess: proposed actions (please react or claim):
  1) continuous heap sampling + jemalloc dumps across canaries (owner?) ETA 72h
  2) per-shard soft caps + background eviction (owner?) ETA 5d
  3) investigate allocator arenas/tcache and recommend malloc_conf (owner?) ETA 10d
  4) memory-drift dashboard + sustained-growth alert (owner?) ETA 3d
  5) oncall runbook updates + repro steps (owner?) ETA 4d

Ramon: I'll take 1). will run pprof snapshots every 5m for selected pods and upload to INF-1702. will paste capture commands in the ticket.

Ivy: I'll pick 2) and 3). plan to implement a conservative soft cap that triggers LRU eviction in background and prototype malloc_conf tweaks in a gated canary. aim for initial canary in 5 days.

Tess: please ensure evictions are non-blocking and emit metrics (evictions/sec, eviction_latency_ms). also add a fallback so requests don't fail.

Ivy: eviction will be background-only; will add counters and a histogram for latency. will coordinate with SRE for the canary rollout.

Ramon: sample capture gist (full script in INF-1702):
```
PODS=$(kubectl get pods -l app=infer -o jsonpath="{.items[*].metadata.name}")
for p in $PODS; do
  kubectl exec $p -- sh -c "pprof -raw /proc/self/exe /tmp/heap.$(date +%s).pprof" || true
  kubectl exec $p -- sh -c "cat /proc/$$/status" > /tmp/jemalloc.$p.$(date +%s).txt || true
done
```
I'll attach the scheduled job once infra creates it.

oncall-bot: created job JOB-204 to collect heap samples; next run in 3 minutes.

Tess: timeline recap: Ramon (sampling) ETA 72h; Ivy (eviction + malloc_conf pilot) ETA 5d; Tess (dashboard + runbook) ETA 4d. sync in 4 days to review numbers.

Ivy: noted. I'll also add a micro-benchmark to the infra repo to stress long-lived sessions and surface fragmentation quickly.

Ramon: uploading initial pprof snapshots to INF-1702 now. will add a brief summary after the first pass.

Tess: thanks all. please update INF-1702 with PR links and tag me on blockers. marking this thread as the action tracker. :white_check_mark:
